# U79: A goal’s history shows the weeks it missed, tells reviews from changes, and can be linked to

- **Belongs to:** the Reviews module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `GOAL-HISTORY`
- **Budget:** at most 6 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at the address “{url('/goals/env-search')}#history”.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U79

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- _Note:_ Portal search has had no check-in since week 39: History says so, week by week (a run of four or more is one entry).
- Go to the address “{url('/goals/env-search')}#history”.
- _Note:_ The page scrolls there once it's drawn (and again after the shell puts a new page at its top).
- **Check:** The History section shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “History” heading in the History section is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `` first === `Week ${NOW} · No check-in` ``, where `const hist = p.locator('#history')`; `const first = (await hist.locator('.stream > li').first().innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: History starts with “{first}”.
- **Check:** “No check-ins (” is shown in the History section (else: a run of missed weeks is not said).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “history”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Changes and Reviews are filters with counts, each count the rows it shows; the filter is in the address.
- Go to `/goals/ns-lead` in the demo.
- **Check:** The History section shows.
- _Note:_ The page can open scrolled to History, under the one-line bar: bring a filter to the middle before pressing it.
- _Note:_ A filter has taken effect once it is the current one and its list is drawn.
- _Note:_ Every row of the filter: Show all when there are more than 12.
- **Check:** The address becomes “history=changes”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `rows === changes && reviewWords === 0`, where `const hist = p.locator('#history')`; `` const filter = (name) => hist.locator('.history-filters').getByRole('link', { name: new RegExp(`^${name} \\d+$`) }) ``; `const counted = async (name) => Number((await filter(name).innerText()).match(/\d+$/)[0])`; `const changes = await counted('Changes')`; `const rows = await hist.locator('.stream > li').count()`; `const reviewWords = await hist.locator('.stream > li').filter({ hasText: /looked at it|added a note/ }).count()`. Else it says: Changes says {changes} and shows {rows} rows, {reviewWords} of them from a review.
- Reload the page.
- **Check:** The History section shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `(await hist.locator('.history-filter[aria-current="true"]').innerText()).startsWith('Changes')`, where `const hist = p.locator('#history')`. Else it says: a reload lost the filter.
- **Check:** The address becomes “history=reviews”.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `rrows === reviews && reviews > 0`, where `const hist = p.locator('#history')`; `` const filter = (name) => hist.locator('.history-filters').getByRole('link', { name: new RegExp(`^${name} \\d+$`) }) ``; `const counted = async (name) => Number((await filter(name).innerText()).match(/\d+$/)[0])`; `const reviews = await counted('Reviews')`; `const rrows = await hist.locator('.stream > li').count()`. Else it says: Reviews says {reviews} and shows {rrows} rows.
- _Note:_ This week's check-in is one entry, and points to Why for its reason rather than saying it again.
- **Check:** “The reason is above, under Why.” is shown in the History section (else: this week’s check-in repeats the reason Why gives).
- _Note:_ A week's entry sits at the end of its week: this week's comment is listed under this week's entry, above last week's.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `thisWeek === 0 && lastWeek > 1 && order.slice(1, lastWeek).includes('row')`, where `const hist = p.locator('#history')`; `const order = await hist.locator('.stream > li').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.id || 'row'))`; `` const thisWeek = order.indexOf(`hist-week-${NOW}`) ``; `` const lastWeek = order.indexOf(`hist-week-${NOW - 1}`) ``; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: History's order: {order.slice(0, 6).join(', ')}.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.changes.some((c) => c.goalId === 'ns-lead')`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: nothing in the change log for the goal.
- Close this browser.
